name: snap_minis_sdk
summary: Server-side Python companion to the Snapchat Snap Minis JavaScript SDK (https://kit.snapchat.com/docs/snap-minis/). Snap Minis is Snapchat's HTML5 mini-app container — minis load inside the Snapchat app and access host functionality (user identity, Bitmoji avatars + sticker picker, friends-who-use-this-mini, Snap Payments, camera Lens hand-off, Spectacles AR cast, CreativeKit share-to-camera) through the `window.snap` global. The JS bridge POSTs every meaningful surface action back to the studio dApp at /dapp/api/snap_mini_event with a bearer freetier token. This connector (a) records every event into ~/.cc/snap_minis_events.jsonl, (b) crystal-anchors each event via inference_logger.log(tier='social_event', model='snap_minis', scope=f'snap_mini_<event_name>'), (c) verifies the signed_user_info HMAC against SNAP_MINI_APP_SECRET so we can trust external_id, and (d) when event_name=='mini.friends.list_pulled' normalizes the Snap friends payload (externalId/displayName/bitmojiAvatarUrl) into the FB-Instant connected_players shape (id/name/picture) and hands it off to the facebook_friends_graph harvester via source='fb_instant'. The SDK_MANIFEST constant documents 15 window.snap.* JS calls (js_call → server_event_name + scope_required + body_schema + description) so the embedded Godot HTML5 build and the studio dApp know what to wire to which event. Stdlib-only (urllib, hmac, hashlib, json, base64). Sibling/mirror of fb_instant_games.py — same shape, same verifier pattern, same JSONL+crystal substrate.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass with SERVICE='snap_minis'. Tool dispatch via send(recipient=tool_name, message=json_args). connect() probes only env vars (no network) and returns True iff SNAP_MINI_APP_ID + SNAP_MINI_APP_SECRET both present — connect status drives whether signed_user_info verification can run, but record_event still works without keys (signed_valid=False). signed_user_info verification is a pure stdlib hmac.compare_digest over `<sig>.<payload>` base64url tokens with HMAC-SHA256(app_secret, payload) — wire format mirrors fb_instant_games signed_player_info exactly so verifiers can share the parse path. Friends-list hand-off has two strategies in order: (1) third_party.facebook_friends_graph.ingest_friends_list if exported at module top-level, else (2) FacebookFriendsGraphConnector.send('harvest_for', {source:'fb_instant', payload:{connected_players: <normalized>}, ...}). Both are wrapped in try/except so this module is useful before agent B is installed.

sdk_manifest_schema_per_entry.js_call: exact window.snap.* signature the in-browser JS bridge should invoke
sdk_manifest_schema_per_entry.scope_required: Snap Kit permission scope the user must have granted (or 'none')
sdk_manifest_schema_per_entry.server_event_name: the dotted event_name the dApp callback POSTs back to /dapp/api/snap_mini_event
sdk_manifest_schema_per_entry.body_schema: expected POST body keys + types (for the dApp + embedded Godot HTML5 build)

env_vars.SNAP_MINI_APP_ID: Snap Kit App ID (kit.snapchat.com → My Apps → App Info). Drives connect() status.
env_vars.SNAP_MINI_APP_SECRET: Snap Kit App Secret. Required to verify signed_user_info HMACs; absent → signed_valid=False on every record.

user_provisioning_required.rationale: Snap Kit issues a separate App ID + Secret pair, unrelated to the Facebook Instant Games credentials. Provisioning fb_instant_games does NOT provision snap_minis_sdk.

convenience_wrappers: record_event(event_name, user_id, signed_data, payload)  — primary entry; called by the JS bridge via the dApp /dapp/api/snap_mini_event POST. Crystal anchor + JSONL sink + friends_list_pulled hand-off (Snap→FB-shape normalized).
verify_signed_data(signed_user_info, app_secret)  — verify the Snap-issued HMAC. Returns {valid, external_id, request_payload, issued_at, error?}. Pure stdlib hmac.
manifest()  — returns the SDK_MANIFEST (15 entries). Consumed by studio/dapp + the embedded Godot HTML5 build to know which JS calls to wire to which server events.
event_stats(since_ts=None)  — counts events in ~/.cc/snap_minis_events.jsonl by event_name; returns {total, by_event_name, first_ts, last_ts}.

SnapMinisSDKConnector.verify_dapp_token(token, expected_domain=None)  — staticmethod wrapper around freetier_gate.verify_token for the dApp handler to bearer-gate every /dapp/api/snap_mini_event POST in one call.

shape_per_line.ts: float — unix seconds at record_event time
shape_per_line.signed_valid: bool — True iff signed_user_info HMAC verified
shape_per_line.payload_summary: dict — redacted summary of the JS-side payload

shape_normalization.rationale: structurally identical — only key names differ; one normalization step lets snap_minis reuse agent B's existing source='fb_instant' code path

friends_harvest_handoff.strategy_1: third_party.facebook_friends_graph.ingest_friends_list(player_id, friends, source_crystal)  — preferred if module exports it at top level
friends_harvest_handoff.strategy_2: FacebookFriendsGraphConnector.send('harvest_for', {player_id, source:'fb_instant', payload:{connected_players: <normalized>}, source_crystal})  — fallback; uses the existing fb_instant source kind
friends_harvest_handoff.wiring: both strategies wrapped in try/except — if agent B is not yet installed or neither strategy succeeds, record_event still succeeds with metadata.friends_handoff={status:'deferred', ingest_friends_list_error, harvest_for_error} and the friends payload is preserved in the event-sink JSONL for later replay.

substrate: ~/.cc/snap_minis_events.jsonl (append-only event sink) + ~/.cc/third_party_logs/snap_minis_sends.jsonl (history) + ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (crystal-anchored social_event records, tier='social_event', model='snap_minis')

inbound_callers: studio/dapp/server.py → POST /dapp/api/snap_mini_event (JS bridge callback; bearer freetier token required)
Godot HTML5 build embedded in a Snap Mini → same /dapp/api/snap_mini_event surface (in-mini events)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: SNAP_MINI_APP_ID + SNAP_MINI_APP_SECRET via studio/auth/keys.load_env (mirrored .env between /data/Projects/MySpace++/.env and /data/Projects/gently/.env)
routing_connections.substrate_writes: snap_minis_events.jsonl (event sink) + send_log entries + crystal_chain social_event records

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.connect: expected_false — SNAP_MINI_APP_ID + SNAP_MINI_APP_SECRET absent from .env (user provisioning pending)
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.record_event: ok — crystal_id anchored on a fake 'mini.initialized' event; event_sink JSONL appended
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.verify_signed_data_round_trip: ok — self-generated <sig>.<payload> verified True; wrong secret → signature_mismatch; 'not_a_dot_string' → malformed

guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every record_event() call appends one InferenceRecord with tier='social_event', model='snap_minis', scope='snap_mini_<event_name>'
Stdlib-only — urllib, hmac, hashlib, json, base64. No snap-kit-sdk, no requests.
Graceful — missing SNAP_MINI_APP_SECRET → signed_valid=False on every record_event but the event is still recorded + crystal-anchored
Redacted logs — signature, signed_data, signed_user_info, access_token, purchase_token, developer_payload stripped from crystal payloads + event-sink summaries
HMAC-verified identity — verify_signed_data(signed_user_info, app_secret) uses hmac.compare_digest for constant-time comparison; never raises
Friends-handoff deferable — agent B may not exist yet; record_event always succeeds and the friends payload is preserved in the JSONL sink
Friends-handoff zero-friction — Snap friend shape normalized to FB-Instant connected_players shape so agent B's existing source='fb_instant' code path handles both sources without modification
Bearer-gateable — SnapMinisSDKConnector.verify_dapp_token wraps freetier_gate.verify_token so /dapp/api/snap_mini_event is one-call gated
Surface-documented — SDK_MANIFEST has 15 entries; every entry includes js_call + server_event_name + scope_required + body_schema + description
sibling_modules: core/lib/third_party/fb_instant_games.py  (Facebook Instant Games JS SDK companion — same shape, same verifier pattern; SHARED friends-graph harvester downstream)
core/lib/third_party/facebook_friends_graph.py  (agent B — friends-graph harvester; receives mini.friends.list_pulled handoff via source='fb_instant' normalized payload)
phase: third_party connector expansion — Snapchat Snap Minis JS SDK companion (event sink + signed-identity verifier + 15-entry surface manifest + FB-Instant-shape friends-handoff bridge)
